svg.title: Choose a notification route from the customer's promise
svg.desc: Three design-only routes serve different promises. For one order-ready push, the application checks consent and device identity, sends through AWS End User Messaging and examines separate provider results; an accepted API request is not proof that the customer saw it. For device registration, Amplify defineNotifications uses Auth, a generated signed API and Connect Customer Profiles; a campaign still needs separate audience, consent, schedule and measurement design. For an offer visible only inside a signed-in page, the application authorizes the exact order before showing data; this is a custom feature, not a migrated Pinpoint in-app campaign. None was deployed or sent in this lab.
svg.text: Start with the promise, then choose the path
A registration, a send and a private page do different jobs.
1 · One order-ready push
Check consent and the intended device.
Send through End User Messaging Push.
Inspect provider events and follow up.
API acceptance does not prove device display.
2 · Register devices for later outreach
Amplify Auth + signed registration API
→ Connect Customer Profiles.
Review push channel secrets and resources.
Design the campaign separately:
audience, consent, timing and measurement.
Default setup can create Connect + a domain.
3 · Show a private offer on the site
Sign in; authorize the exact order.
Read selected data; render the page.
A custom app feature, not a migrated
Pinpoint in-app campaign.
Design only: no Connect resource, provider credential,
message, recipient or AWS credit used here.
